query:
SELECT format('%s %s %s %s: %s; check: %s', policyname, permissive, cmd, roles::text,
                      COALESCE(regexp_replace(qual, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 'none'),
                      COALESCE(with_check, 'none')) AS "policy!"
          FROM pg_policies
         WHERE schemaname = 'public'
